title: Eating and drinking at the end of life, a project of the Erlangen Palliative Medicine Biobank, PaBE Therapieresistant tumor-cachexia-anorexia syndrom and thiamine deficiency
summary:
The aim is to record the frequency of therapy-limiting tumour
cachexia-anorexia syndrome (TKAS) and symptomatic
thiamine deficiency.
Data collection takes place within the framework of routine clinical examinations, and additional study-related measures consist of obtaining biological samples (blood and urine) for research into suitable biomarker panels.

interventions.name:
VIT: Vitamin deficiency syndrome and uptake in thiamine metabolism
Blood sampling and examination of markers: free thiamine, lactate, troponin, IL-6, magnesium, potassium, phosphate

FIRST: Cancer-cachexia-anorexia-syndrome, , 
Food Intake in Refractory States of Tumor Cachexia
Blood sampling and examination of marker panel: CRP, ferritin, IL-6, albumin, glucose, ketone bodies, lactate, CK, urea, creatinine

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Informed consent
Exclusion criteria:
Infectious diseases, 
burden of disease too high
